parent_v7.role: v7 establishes how world-universe direction changes certificate persistence; v8 keeps the full directed candidate universe and asks how to carry its future uncertainty forward without selecting one world

scientific_question: Can future distribution uncertainty be represented as an exact set of world-specific reachable configurations whose lower/upper envelope remains truth-sound and contracts monotonically as temporal positive evidence accumulates?

latent_worlds.reuse: the exact v5 directed 7x7 latent rows, truth source/outlet flow field, A/B permissibility, three barrier levels and three analyst environmental rules
latent_worlds.candidate_worlds: every A/B-permissive candidate source x three barrier levels x three analyst rules
latent_worlds.truth_world: directed relative_edge_q70 world at the truth row's barrier level and frozen truth source

forecast_time_design.truth_max_depth: maximum directed BFS depth among truth-reachable nodes
forecast_time_design.eligibility: truth max depth >=3 and at least one non-source truth-positive node before the terminal frontier
forecast_time_design.future_target: the binary node membership configuration reachable from a candidate source within H directed graph steps
forecast_time_design.truth_future_configuration: truth-world nodes with truth BFS depth <=H

nested_temporal_evidence.level_early: truth-positive nodes with BFS depth <= max(1, floor((H-1)/3))
nested_temporal_evidence.level_mid: truth-positive nodes with BFS depth <= max(level_early_cutoff, floor(2*(H-1)/3))
nested_temporal_evidence.level_prefrontier: all truth-positive nodes with BFS depth <= H-1
nested_temporal_evidence.compatibility: candidate world survives when every observed node is reachable with candidate BFS distance <= its truth BFS depth
nested_temporal_evidence.duplicates: nested levels with identical cutoff are collapsed before scoring but retain their declared label mapping

set_valued_forecast.per_world_configuration: set of locally A/B-permissive nodes with candidate directed BFS distance <=H
set_valued_forecast.configuration_set: all distinct per-world future configurations among survivors
set_valued_forecast.world_support_fraction: fraction of survivor worlds whose future configuration contains the node; descriptive world frequency, explicitly not a calibrated probability

point_collapse_comparator.rule: majority future configuration: predict node reachable when world_support_fraction >=0.5
point_collapse_comparator.role: diagnostic comparator showing what can be lost by collapsing a set-valued forecast to one deterministic configuration

primary_outputs: survivor-world count by temporal evidence level
rows where world identity contracts but forecast envelope does not
rows where forecast envelope strictly contracts

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At every eligible row and evidence level, the truth future configuration contains the lower envelope and is contained by the upper envelope.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: Within every eligible row, survivor-world count, distinct future-configuration count and contingent-future node count are all nonincreasing as temporal evidence accumulates.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any violation is an implementation/theory failure.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row has a strict survivor-world reduction between nested evidence levels while contingent-future node count remains unchanged.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if every strict world contraction also shrinks the nodewise forecast envelope.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row has a strict reduction in contingent-future node count between nested evidence levels.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if no forecast envelope ever contracts.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row/evidence level has a nonzero majority point-forecast node error while the set-valued envelope remains truth-sound.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if majority collapse is always exactly correct.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one eligible row retains more than one distinct future configuration after all truth positives through H-1 are supplied.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if prefrontier evidence always collapses the future-configuration set to one.

predeclared_hypotheses.statement: At least one nested evidence transition changes survivor-world count without changing contingent-future node count, and at least one transition changes contingent-future node count by a different proportion than survivor-world count.
predeclared_hypotheses.failure_rule: REFUTED if forecast width is perfectly determined by survivor-world count across all transitions.

secondary_outputs: distribution of world_support_fraction on contingent nodes
relation between configuration-set size and nodewise envelope width
majority error by environmental autocorrelation, neighbourhood and barrier density
rows with singleton nodewise envelope but multiple world identities
rows with multiple configurations but zero majority error
claim_boundary: World-support fraction is not a posterior probability because candidate worlds are not probability-weighted.
Graph depth H is structural propagation depth, not calibrated time.
Envelope coverage is conditional on truth-world retention and the declared finite candidate universe.
The majority comparator is a deterministic collapse diagnostic, not a proposed optimal predictor.
stop_rules: Do not change H or temporal evidence cutoffs after scoring.
Do not add world weights after scoring.
Do not replace the majority comparator after seeing its error rate.
Do not drop rows with wide forecast envelopes.
